identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase III Study of ESG401 for Locally Advanced or Metastatic HR+/HER2- Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Open-label, Randomized, Multicenter Phase III Study of ESG401 Versus Investigator's Choice Chemotherapy in Patients With Locally Advanced or Metastatic HR+/HER2- Breast Cancer Who Had Failed at Least One Line of Chemotherapy

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The aim of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of ESG401 in patients with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic HR+/HER2- breast cancer.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This is a open-label, randomized, multicenter Phase 3 study to evaluate ESG401 versus Treatment of Physician's Choice (TPC) in subjects with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic HR+/HER2- breast cancer who had failed at least one line of systemic chemotherapy.

armGroups.label: ESG401 for injection
armGroups.description: IV infusion on day 1, 8 and15 of each 28 day cycle

armGroups.label: Treatment of Physician's Choice
armGroups.description:
Eribulin 1.4 mg/m2, IV infusion on day 1 and 8 of each 21 day cycle

Capecitabine 1000 or 1250 mg/m2, po, from day 1 to 14 of each 21 day cycle

Vinorelbine 25 mg/m2, IV infusion on day 1 and 8 of each 21 day cycle

Gemcitabine 1000 mg/m2, IV infusion on day 1,8 and 15 of each 28day cycle
interventionNames: Drug: Eribulin, capecitabine, gemcitabine or vinorelbine (Treatment of Physician's Choice)

interventions.name: ESG401
interventions.description: IV infusion on day 1,8, and 15 of each 28 day cycle

interventions.name: Eribulin, capecitabine, gemcitabine or vinorelbine (Treatment of Physician's Choice)

primaryOutcomes.measure: Progression-free survival (PFS) assessed by IRC per RECIST 1.1
primaryOutcomes.description: PFS was defined as the time from randomization to PD or death, whichever occurs first.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Progression-free survival (PFS) assessed by the investigators per RECIST V 1.1
secondaryOutcomes.description: PFS was defined as the time from randomization to PD or death, whichever occurs first.
OS was defined as the time from randomization to death.
ORR was defined as the proportion of of patients with a CR and PR assessed by IRC and investigators per RECIST v 1.1
CBR was defined as the proportion of patients with a CR or PR or with SD at Week 24 assessed by IRC and investigators per RECIST v 1.1
From the date that response criteria are first met to the first occurrence of PD as determined by BIRC and investigators per RECIST v1.1 or death from any cause, whichever occurs first.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Quality of life evaluated using the NCC-BC-A scale
secondaryOutcomes.description: To assess the impact of ESG401 on disease related symptoms and quality of life of patients using the NCC-BC-A scale

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Adverse events(AEs) and severe adverse events (SAEs)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Incidence and severity of AEs and SAEs (per CTCAE 5.0), and clinically significant abnormal laboratory findings
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From signing the ICF up to last dose plus 30 days

secondaryOutcomes.description: Mean population clearance will be derived from pooled data of drug concentrations. Covariates of influence on drug clearance will be incorporated within a population pharmacokinetic model.

Mean population volume of distribution will be derived from pooled data of drug concentrations. Covariates of influence on volume of distribution will be incorporated within a population pharmacokinetic model.
